vocabulary.meaning_en: a very short talk to sell an idea, short enough for a ride in a lift
vocabulary.meaning_ar: عرض موجز لفكرة (يُقدَّم في وقت قصير جدًا، كمدة ركوب المصعد)
vocabulary.note_ar: elevator كلمة أمريكية، والبريطانيون يقولون lift.
vocabulary.note_en: Elevator is American English; British people say lift.
vocabulary.example: I had only two minutes, so I gave him my elevator pitch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that carries people up and down in a building
vocabulary.example: Let's take the lift to the fifth floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a talk to persuade someone to accept an idea or buy something; to give this talk
vocabulary.meaning_ar: عرض ترويجي / يعرض فكرة لإقناع الآخرين
vocabulary.example: She pitched her idea to the manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to think of a new idea or plan
vocabulary.example: Our team came up with a great plan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something a company makes and sells
vocabulary.example: This is our best-selling product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something new that is added and makes a group better
vocabulary.example: The new printer is a useful addition to the office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the group of people or businesses who might buy a product
vocabulary.example: Our market is small cafes and restaurants.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money a business earns after paying its costs
vocabulary.example: The company made a big profit this year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making money
vocabulary.example: Is this a profitable business?

vocabulary.meaning_en: doing work well without wasting time or money
vocabulary.example: New machines will increase efficiency.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how good something is
vocabulary.example: We never reduce the quality of our products.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep something at the same level
vocabulary.example: We must maintain high standards.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to become or make bigger; a rise
vocabulary.note_ar: نبرة الفعل على المقطع الثاني: inCREASE، والاسم على الأول: INcrease.
vocabulary.note_en: Verb stress: inCREASE; noun stress: INcrease.
vocabulary.example: Sales increased by 10% last month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working out an answer with numbers
vocabulary.example: By my calculations, the project will cost less.

vocabulary.meaning_en: worth the price you pay
vocabulary.example: These chairs are good value for money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: much better than usual
vocabulary.example: She did an exceptional job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a set of questions you ask many people to find information
vocabulary.example: We did a survey of 200 customers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to organise and do something, e.g. a survey
vocabulary.example: We conducted a survey last month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a customer who already buys from you
vocabulary.example: We sent the offer to all existing customers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: facts that show something is true
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود: لا نقول evidences.
vocabulary.example: Do you have any evidence that it will sell?

vocabulary.meaning_en: using few words, clearly
vocabulary.example: Please explain your idea concisely.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sure that something will happen or be good
vocabulary.example: I'm confident we will finish on time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the range of products a company sells
vocabulary.example: This new item will add to our product portfolio.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to prepare well by finding information before something
vocabulary.example: You've really done your homework on this market.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to think carefully about something before deciding
vocabulary.example: Let me chew it over and I'll call you tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to contact someone later with an answer
vocabulary.example: I'll get back to you by Friday.

fine_lines.title: lift vs elevator
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان بمعنى واحد: المصعد. lift هي الكلمة البريطانية، و elevator هي الكلمة الأمريكية. أما elevator pitch فهو تعبير ثابت يُستخدم في الإنجليزيتين.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the machine that carries people between floors. Lift is British, elevator is American. 'Elevator pitch' is a fixed phrase used everywhere.

examples.sentence: The lift is out of order, so take the stairs.
The elevator stopped on the tenth floor.

fine_lines.title: profit vs benefit
fine_lines.explanation_ar: profit هو المال الذي تربحه الشركة بعد طرح التكاليف. benefit فائدة أو ميزة بشكل عام، وليس مالًا بالضرورة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Profit is money a business makes after costs. Benefit is any advantage or good result, not only money.

examples.sentence: One benefit of the plan is that it saves time.

expressions.phrase: We've come up with an exciting new product.
expressions.meaning_en: We have created a new and interesting product.
expressions.example: We've come up with an exciting new app for students.

expressions.phrase: This fantastic product will be a great addition to ...
expressions.meaning_ar: هذا المنتج الرائع سيكون إضافة ممتازة إلى ...
expressions.example: This fantastic chair will be a great addition to any office.

expressions.phrase: We can increase efficiency but maintain quality.
expressions.meaning_ar: يمكننا رفع الكفاءة مع المحافظة على الجودة.
expressions.meaning_en: We can work faster and cheaper without making the product worse.
expressions.example: With the new software, we can increase efficiency but maintain quality.

expressions.phrase: By my calculations, we can increase profits by 20%.
expressions.meaning_ar: حسب حساباتي، يمكننا زيادة الأرباح بنسبة 20٪.
expressions.meaning_en: According to my numbers, profits can grow by 20%.
expressions.example: By my calculations, we can save 15% on costs.

expressions.phrase: I'm confident this new product will be a huge success.
expressions.meaning_ar: أنا واثق أن هذا المنتج الجديد سيحقق نجاحًا كبيرًا.
expressions.meaning_en: I strongly believe this product will do very well.
expressions.example: I'm confident this course will be a huge success.

expressions.phrase: There's no time like the present.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا وقت أفضل من الآن (لا تؤجّل).
expressions.meaning_en: It's best to do it now, not later.
expressions.example: Let's send the report today – there's no time like the present.
Great report – you've certainly done your homework.

expressions.phrase: Let me chew it over and I'll get back to you.
expressions.meaning_ar: دعني أفكر في الأمر وسأعود إليك بالرد.
expressions.meaning_en: Let me think about it and I'll answer you later.
expressions.example: It's a good offer. Let me chew it over and I'll get back to you.

grammar.title: increase / reduce by + amount
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم by بعد increase أو reduce أو rise أو fall لنذكر مقدار التغيير: increase profits by 20% أي بمقدار 20٪. أما to فتذكر الرقم النهائي: increase to 500.
grammar.explanation_en: Use 'by' after increase, reduce, rise or fall to give the size of the change. Use 'to' to give the final number.

grammar.title: will for confident predictions
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم will + الفعل الأساسي للتنبؤ بالمستقبل عندما نكون واثقين، وغالبًا بعد I'm confident / I'm sure / I think.
grammar.explanation_en: Use will + base verb to make predictions, often after I'm confident, I'm sure or I think.
examples: I'm confident this product will be a huge success.
It will be a great addition to the range.
I'm sure customers will love it.

grammar.title: Present perfect for recent results
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/has + التصريف الثالث للحديث عن عمل انتهى حديثًا ونتيجته مهمة الآن: We've come up with... / We've conducted a survey.
grammar.explanation_en: Use have/has + past participle for recent actions with a result now.
examples: We've come up with a new idea.
She has found ten new customers.

questions.question: What is an 'elevator pitch'?
choices: a very short talk to sell an idea
a meeting in a lift about safety
questions.explanation_ar: elevator pitch عرض قصير جدًا لفكرة في وقت قليل.
questions.explanation_en: It's a very short talk to sell an idea.

questions.question: We've ___ an exciting new product.
questions.explanation_ar: come up with تعني ابتكر فكرة، و We've تحتاج التصريف الثالث come.
questions.explanation_en: 'Come up with' means think of; after 'we've' we use 'come'.

questions.question: By my calculations, we can increase profits ___ 20%.
questions.explanation_en: Use 'by' for the size of a change.

questions.question: What does 'efficiency' mean?
choices: doing work well without wasting time or money
questions.explanation_ar: efficiency تعني الكفاءة: إنجاز العمل دون هدر.
questions.explanation_en: Efficiency means working well without waste.

questions.question: Which word is British English for 'elevator'?
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I'm confident this product is being a success.
I'm confident this product will be a huge success.
I'm confident this product will is a success.
I'm confident this product be a huge success.

questions.question: Paul says 'Let me chew it over.' What does he mean?
choices: He wants to think about it carefully.
He wants to eat a biscuit.
questions.explanation_ar: chew it over تعني يفكر في الأمر بتمعّن.
questions.explanation_en: It means to think carefully before deciding.

questions.question: 'You've certainly done your homework' means you have ___.
questions.explanation_ar: do your homework هنا تعني الاستعداد الجيد وجمع المعلومات.

questions.question: Anna conducted a ___ and found ten new companies who would buy the product.
questions.explanation_ar: survey استطلاع آراء، وconduct a survey أي أجرى استطلاعًا.
questions.explanation_en: We conduct a survey to collect information.

questions.question: Which word best completes: 'These chairs are good value for ___.'
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الثابت هو value for money.
questions.explanation_en: The fixed phrase is 'value for money'.
